mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diary (user_id, emotion, emotion_label, title, content, images, is_public, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{emotion}, #{emotionLabel}, #{title}, #{content}, #{images}, #{isPublic}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, emotion, emotion_label, title, content, images, is_public, create_time, update_time FROM diary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, user_id, emotion, emotion_label, title, content, images, is_public, create_time, update_time FROM diary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE diary SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE diary SET is_deleted = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, emotion, emotion_label, title, content, images, is_public, create_time, update_time FROM diary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND DATE(create_time) = #{date} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, user_id, emotion, emotion_label, title, content, images, is_public, create_time, update_time FROM diary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, user_id, emotion, emotion_label, title, content, images, is_public, create_time, update_time FROM diary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND is_public = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
